title: Logitech CEO Hanneke Faber on AI Agents & The Great Tech Divide
text: Logitech CEO Hanneke Faber joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the findings of the company's CTRL Tomorrow study on how tech impacts its users, finding opportunity in the AI era, and why design-led hardware still has a major role to play. Faber speaks with Bloomberg's Carol Massar and Jess Menton. (Source: Bloomberg)
